title: Ankhorage Storage
summary: Defines provider-neutral object-storage operations, capability descriptors, and the StoragePort boundary.
purpose: Provide common upload, removal, listing, and URL-resolution operations so applications can use object storage without coupling to a provider SDK.
domain: object storage capabilities and provider-neutral ports
responsibilities: Publish the storage upload, remove, list, and resolve capability catalog.
Define the StoragePort boundary for provider-specific storage adapters.
Use portable storage contracts at the public capability boundary.
boundaries: Does not implement a concrete object-storage provider client or credential integration.
Does not select or compose a storage adapter for an application.
Does not persist application-specific asset workflows.
audience: Application and runtime authors that invoke provider-neutral object storage.
Maintainers of provider adapters that implement StoragePort.
useCases: Describe an object upload without selecting a storage provider.
List, remove, or resolve stored objects through common operations.
Implement a storage provider adapter against the published StoragePort.

architecture.role: Provider-neutral storage boundary library with explicit port and capability catalog.
invariants: Concrete provider behavior remains behind adapters.
Capability inputs and outputs use published portable contracts.
Consumers use public package exports rather than provider-specific internals.

limitations: Applications must configure a concrete storage adapter separately.
The package does not perform storage I/O by itself.
